ask_armitage: Is the Elmore picture an original watercolour (not a print), and is there a label on the back, a signature and a date? Can they send a photo of the back and the signature?
viewing_check: Look at the image under a loupe: a print shows a dot or line screen and a uniformly flat paper surface; an original shows pigment pooling, paper cockle and brush edges. Check the signature is not printed, and the back for the sealed backing and any gallery label. Jack's median result is about A$400-550, so a small streetscape at $400 opening is near the market if original; if it is a print it is worth about $50-280.
flip_reason: original Jack town scenes sold A$295-1,198 on eBay in 3 yrs; print only A$280; opening bid $400 (~A$488 with premium) leaves little room unless original and larger than average
